question.text: The patient is given prophylactic labetalol and magnesium sulfate. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in the management of this patient?

options.A: Stop magnesium sulfate and give calcium gluconate
options.C: Stop magnesium sulfate and give lorazepam
options.F: I don't know or cannot answer
